text: Independent acceptance complete. Evidence: imageJVM/test 161/161, imageJS/test 159/159, datasetJVM/test 61/61, datasetJS/test 37/37, fmriWorkflowJVM/test 20/20, fmriWorkflowJS/test 17/17; final sbt compileAll and sbt testAll both succeeded on the final tree. WorkflowIngestAcceptanceSuite proves header-first compilation and lazy mixed-endian, mixed-datatype, scaled multi-run reads with one gzip input, staging reuse, run-mask intersection, arbitrary global time order, and analytic tolerance oracle. Dataset suites separately prove full and dense one-window plans, bounded sparse windows with scatter order, censored time partitioning, max-window splitting, and failed gzip cleanup with no finalized or partial artifact. Planner structural baseline for 200 TR x 50k voxels: windowsPerTimepoint=1, plannedReads=200 versus 10000000 element reads, plannedBytes=80798400, maxBufferBytes=403992. Benchmark receipt: sbt datasetJVM/Test/runMain scalafim.dataset.io.NiftiReadBenchmark; elapsedSeconds=0.065, throughputMiBPerSecond=1182.2; wall clock is informational only. Raw independent fixtures cover uint8, int16, int32, float32, float64, big endian, slope/intercept, zero-slope, truncation, unsupported datatype, and bitpix mismatch. Workflow tests cover confounds absent/requested, Explicit, RequireCommonDerivative, IntersectRunMasks, all reachable catalog codes, and every retained preflight code. Caveat: CatalogIssueCode.InvalidUnit is a defensive invariant mapping not constructible from valid public compiler inputs; the corresponding unit and catalog smart-constructor failures are covered in WorkflowTypesSuite. Final scans found no JVM imports in shared sources, reverse workflow dependency, nested-vector NIfTI hot-path rebuild, workflow asInstanceOf or guarded gets, pipeline import, trailing whitespace, or git diff errors. Dataset and workflow READMEs plus module-relations document the contracts.
